title: Electronic descriptors of a methylsulfanyl benzyl-alcohol radical cation
category: computational chemistry / mechanistic physical organic chemistry
difficulty_reasons: The supplied radical-cation endpoint is fixed, but the Agent must independently choose and validate an electronic-structure route and construct a like-defined methoxy comparator.

paper.title: Electrochemistry Facilitates the Chemoselectivity of Benzylic Alcohol Oxidations Mediated by Flavin-Based Photoredox Catalysis

data.description: Public 20-atom XYZ structure for the isolated 4-(methylsulfanyl)benzyl alcohol radical cation; charge +1 and doublet state are specified in the XYZ comment and task.

required_deliverables.description: JSON report containing methods, mapping, validation, spin density, both BDEs, limitations, and conclusion.
